newsitem.title: UK: Ferraris says like-for like Q1 sales ahead.
newsitem.headline: Ferraris says like-for like Q1 sales ahead.

text.p: International products and services group Ferraris Group Plc said it had begun its current year to September on a sound note, with like-for-like sales and order intake up 30 percent compared with the previous year.
The company's chairman, Ken Barker, told shareholders at its annual meeting that order intake and sales were ahead in the first quarter by over 40 percent in absolute terms.
"With order books at record levels and continuing strong markets for our products and services in all divisions, the group is well on course to achieve further growth," Barker said.
The company's share price gained 2p to 120 after his review.
